title: MISSION THE CHINO
style: cumbia pop, salsa merengue, 98 BPM, guiro and clave, horn stabs, bass guitar tumbao, accordion melody, timbales fills, live congas, snare backbeat, call-and-response chorus, minor key, 90s Latin pop sheen, tape saturation, short plate reverb, anthemic resilience, crew loyalty
lyrics:
In San Juan del Sur
they know the way he moves,
El Chino opens the door
before the break of dawn.
He carries the list in his head,
looks at it without a doubt,
if Allen says “get it done”
then it’s getting done.
More than fifteen years together,
never falling, never failing,
he handles the hard stuff
like it was just yesterday.
[Pre-Chorus]
If Allen’s far away,
he takes care of the place,
with the key close to his chest
and a clear path ahead.
Everything stays in order,
everything turns out right,
’cause El Chino gets it handled
before they even ask.
[Chorus]
El Chino never fails
(El Chino never fails)
even the impossible gets done
(even the impossible gets done)
Allen’s face is at peace
the house stays calm
El Chino never fails
he never fails at all
[Verse 2]
If a move is missing,
he’s gonna find it fast,
if the pressure rises,
he knows how to bring it down.
He checks every detail,
doesn’t let anything slip,
what the boss orders
he turns into reality.
Allen trusts him fully,
he can rest easy,
he knows that in Nicaragua
everything’s gonna run smooth.
And in every steady step
you can feel the strong bond,
a team made of steel
built with pure hustle.
[Pre-Chorus]
If Allen’s far away,
he takes care of the place,
with the key close to his chest
and a clear path ahead.
Everything stays in order,
everything turns out right,
’cause El Chino gets it handled
before they even ask.
[Chorus]
El Chino never fails
(El Chino never fails)
even the impossible gets done
(even the impossible gets done)
Allen’s face is at peace
the house stays calm
El Chino never fails
he never fails at all
[Bridge]
Fifteen years on these streets,
through the dust and loyalty,
one hand in the shadows
and one out in the city.
When the boss gives the order from above,
he sends the signal down,
’cause a great team
was built on truth.
[Chorus]
El Chino never fails
(El Chino never fails)
even the impossible gets done
(even the impossible gets done)
Allen’s face is at peace
the house stays calm
El Chino never fails
he never fails at all
